title: Density Measurement and PC-SAFT/tPC-PSAFT Modeling of the CO2 + H2O System over a Wide Temperature Range
experimental_method: Compressed-liquid densities of deionized water and CO2 + H2O solutions at fixed CO2 mole fractions measured at 274-413 K and 10-18 MPa in a closed-cell vibrating-tube type apparatus (density from mass and volume as described in the paper's Experimental Section).
uncertainties_stated: u(T) = 0.01 K, u(P) = 0.001 MPa, u(x1) = 0.0002 mol/mol, combined expanded uncertainty U(rho) = 0.29 kg/m3.
quality_remarks: Pure-water densities agree with NIST (ARD 0.03 %). Temperature scale not stated. Mole fractions x1 are fixed compositions of the single-phase liquid (0.0042, 0.0084, 0.0124). Authors compare density differences with Li et al.
